div.div:
wav_to_iq.py + dcf77_soft_decode.py
1. read WAV → float64
2. complex LO mix at --if-hz (default 5 kHz) → DCF77 lands at DC
3. LPF @ 60 Hz on each of I, Q
4. decimate to 1 kS/s
5. joint peak-normalise I, Q to int16
6. 3-template matched-filter decode + two-frame agreement
⇒ recovered timestamp + signal_present / expect_full_decode flags
(compare against .expect sidecar if present, warn on mismatch)
7. write derived/.s16 + .meta
Skip-if-up-to-date (mtime of outputs vs WAV); --force overrides.

div.div:
run.py: _configure_replay_testbench
For each samples/*.wav whose derived/.s16 + .meta exist:
• register dcf77_rx_replay_tb.smoke.
MAX_SAMPLES = 130 · rate
EXPECT_VALIDATE_TIME = false
EXPECT_DECODE_PROGRESS = (expect_full_decode == 1)
EXPECT_YEAR .. EXPECT_DST from .meta
• register dcf77_rx_replay_tb.full_decode.
only if expect_full_decode==1 AND env DCF77_FULL_REPLAY=1
MAX_SAMPLES = 0 (feed entire file), EXPECT_VALIDATE_TIME = true
The .s16 path is passed to the TB as the REPLAY_FILE string generic.

div.div:
06_dcf77_rx_replay_tb.vhd
stim process: open REPLAY_FILE, read 4 bytes/tick (LE int16 I, LE int16 Q),
sign-extend to sfixed(21..0); drive env.i_in / q_in / in_valid
every CLOCKS_PER_TICK clocks (= 8 → 64 ns/sample)
DUT chain: env → bit_det → frame_dec (NCO, mixer, CIC stages all bypassed)
monitor process: VUnit info() per bit_valid, minute_mark, sync transition,
edge-detected time_valid (visible with run.py -v)
smoke: if EXPECT_DECODE_PROGRESS → assert bits_seen ≥ 30 ∧ minutes_seen ≥ 1
full_decode: assert time_valid='1' ∧ decoded fields match EXPECT_YEAR..EXPECT_DST
